deltas.before: An unknown control-status result is swallowed and control-start is attempted.
deltas.requirement: One fatal session latch; an effectful control-status result cannot authorize another effect after uncertainty.

deltas.before: The control-restart procedure can select a matching receipt retained from an earlier fault.
deltas.after: Require increased ownership epoch and a receipt absent from the exact pre-fault history, as serial trials already do. Expiry returns gate-deadline without publishing a receipt.
deltas.requirement: A stale takeover cannot qualify a new fault.
deltas.origin: Independent owner-invariant fixture; no changed frozen TypeScript observation is claimed.

deltas.before: Relay polling catches every inspection error and continues.
deltas.after: Only definite pure-read failures can be observed again; an unknown result stops immediately.
deltas.requirement: No replay or further host effects after unknown completion.
deltas.origin: Independent owner-invariant fixture; no changed frozen TypeScript observation is claimed.

deltas.before: Failover polling counts every store read error as missing and continues.
deltas.after: An explicitly unknown store observation stops the procedure; only definite read failures can be observed again.
deltas.requirement: The session latch and no-replay rule also cover optional resource capabilities.
deltas.origin: Independent owner-invariant fixture; no changed frozen TypeScript observation is claimed.

deltas.before: Collection telemetry catches unknown observations as missing samples and invokes the observer again.
deltas.after: Stop observation calls after command-result-unknown, retain the reason through expiry, and preserve terminal collection failure evidence.
deltas.requirement: Unknown observation completion cannot authorize another effect or hide known failure.

representations.description: Go RFC3339 omits zero fractional seconds; receipt comparisons preserve the exact instant and compare other fields without normalization.
Object key order is canonicalized for history comparison; omitted fields, explicit false, time spelling and unknown metadata remain distinct.
Host staging accepts arm64, amd64 and canonical x86_64. Product archives use amd64; the template downloader receives x86_64 for either x86 input. The default remains arm64; paid inputs are unchanged.
Historical takeover start may be absent. A new takeover uses the independently observed signal start; missing end remains invalid evidence.

Endpoint validation accepts environment-owned HTTP hostnames or IPs and integer ports. Fixed media identity is still checked against the selected worker endpoints; no provider-specific host or service port is assumed.
Fixed completion procedures require completed=true in the confirmed host envelope. Known positive loss or self-fence counters survive unrelated malformed evidence without clearing uncertainty.
Signal nanoseconds remain unsigned decimal values through conversion to Go seconds and nanoseconds, without floating-point or signed overflow.
